decision_rule.vi: Dùng đúng kích thước, số chiều và vùng collision của nguồn; không gộp Main+Spare với bảng 100×10.
decision_rule.en: Use the source dimensions and collision region exactly; do not merge Main+Spare with the 100×10 table.

variants.invariant: The complete physical domain uses one empty representation.

decision_rule.vi: Phép khởi tạo, kiểm ô trống, chèn và tìm phải dùng cùng empty record/sentinel; không coi dữ liệu hợp lệ là rỗng.
decision_rule.en: Initialisation, empty checks, insertion, and search must share one empty record/sentinel without classifying valid data as empty.

variants.invariant: Empty-state recognition is consistent across operations.

decision_rule.vi: Chọn MOD 200 cho 200 địa chỉ chính hoặc MOD 100 cho 100 hàng; nêu miền khóa trước khi suy luận về số âm.
decision_rule.en: Use MOD 200 for 200 primary addresses or MOD 100 for 100 rows; state the key domain before reasoning about negative keys.

variants.invariant: Returned address belongs to the primary address domain.

decision_rule.vi: Sau va chạm, quét Spare toàn cục hoặc cột còn lại của đúng bucket theo đề; dừng ở ô trống đầu tiên.
decision_rule.en: After collision, scan global Spare or the remaining columns of the exact bucket as prescribed; stop at the first empty slot.

variants.invariant: A successful insertion changes exactly one permitted slot.

decision_rule.vi: Nếu nguồn không định nghĩa duplicate/full, giữ chúng là policy/fixture được công bố; Not found chỉ xuất hiện sau khi hết miền tìm hợp lệ.
decision_rule.en: When the source does not define duplicate/full behavior, keep them as declared policy/fixtures; return Not found only after exhausting the valid search region.

variants.invariant: No boundary path overwrites silently or leaves the index domain.

decision_rule.vi: Python dict phù hợp khi đề chỉ cần ánh xạ trực tiếp; các bài B5 yêu cầu bằng chứng về MOD, sentinel, collision và probe nên phải dùng cấu trúc hash tường minh.
decision_rule.en: A Python dict suits a direct mapping contract; B5 parts require observable MOD, sentinel, collision, and probe evidence, so use the explicit hash structure.

variants.invariant: The implementation exposes every operation assessed by the chosen contract.

decision_rule.vi: Từ class table tạo map field/type/visibility/source-of-value.
decision_rule.en: Build a field/type/visibility/value-source map from the class table.

cases.initialisation: distinct child/default element per required slot

variants.invariant: Immediately after construction every required field exists once, with exact identifier and source-defined value.

decision_rule.vi: Chia parameters thành parent slice và subclass slice trước super call.
decision_rule.en: Partition parameters into parent and subclass slices before the super call.

cases.order: super(parent args), then one subclass assignment
super(parent args), then each new field exactly once

variants.invariant: Parent invariant holds after super; subclass invariant holds after new-field initialisation.

decision_rule.vi: Chọn stored member và optional index từ method contract.
decision_rule.en: Select the stored member and optional index from the method contract.

variants.invariant: Getter returns stored value/type and leaves the entire object unchanged.

decision_rule.vi: Dùng equation: không có field_before là Set; có field_before/formula/bound là Update.
decision_rule.en: Use the equation: no field_before means Set; field_before/formula/bound means Update.

variants.invariant: Only named targets change; after-state satisfies the exact source equation and bounds.

decision_rule.vi: Tính parent side effects rồi chọn call/extend/reimplement strategy để mỗi obligation xảy ra đúng một lần.
decision_rule.en: Count parent side effects, then choose call/extend/reimplement so every obligation occurs once.

cases.example: bonus-adjusted hours passed to parent SetPay

variants.invariant: Same callable contract dispatches to subclass behaviour without duplicate parent side effects.

decision_rule.vi: Map one complete source record/fixed tuple to one constructor call and one storage destination.
decision_rule.en: Map one complete source record/fixed tuple to one constructor call and one storage destination.

variants.invariant: After k source tuples exactly k valid, correctly typed object instances are reachable in required positions.

decision_rule.vi: Dùng count làm next-free slot và capacity làm full boundary trong observed Station contract.
decision_rule.en: Use count as next-free slot and capacity as full boundary in the observed Station contract.

variants.invariant: 0<=count<=capacity; success adds the exact object once and failure preserves all state.
